messages:
Marta: Run tp/8 ci job tp-2026-03-16-4 shows intermittent p99 spikes on TP all-reduces when kvcache miss bursts.
Jon: Which op shape? ring vs tree behaving differently?
Marta: From perf dump: small-fragment allreduces (4–14KB) show ring avg lower but p99 higher. tree raises avg but tightens tail. correlates with heavy kvcache miss periods that fragment messages.
Sahil: That matches hypothesis: kvcache misses -> many tiny accumulates. We saw microbatch=8 + seq=2048 in those runs.
Kevin: paste the profiler extract.
Marta: snippet:
```
PERF SNAPSHOT tp/8 model=redwood-7b
config: microbatch=8, seq=2048, batch=2
kvcache hit-rate: 71% (miss bursts ~28%)
allreduce (ring): avg=1.2ms p95=2.6ms p99=6.1ms msg=4-14KB
allreduce (tree): avg=1.9ms p95=2.2ms p99=3.0ms msg=4-14KB
compute overlap: 58% (drops on final tp slices)
kernel-path: prefer_ring_if_msg>=16KB
```
Jon: So current selector bias is too coarse. We should adapt per-window message distribution.
Sahil: Proposal: maintain sliding hist of msg sizes + kvcache miss ratio; pick tree if p50 msg < 12KB AND miss_rate>15%.
Kevin: Also option to coalesce adjacent allreduces in the TP scheduler when safe to do so. If we can merge endpoints to reach ~32KB boundary we get ring benefits without tail penalty.
Marta: Two candidate changes:
- Runtime heuristic: windowed msg p50 + miss-rate threshold -> tree
- Scheduler coalesce: merge comm ops within same microbatch epoch up to 32KB
Sahil: I'll run a 4-way sweep (baseline, heuristic-only, coalesce-only, both) on 8xA100 with microbatch=8 and microbatch=16 combos.
Kevin: Watch out: tree fallback can change kernel selection for fused-gemm kernels; need perf counters check (L2 miss, instruction throughput) to avoid regressions.
Marta: noted. I'll add kernel-validation step to perf job to detect known regression signatures (see eng-runtime issue 312).
perf-bot: queued perf sweep: tp-sweep-1768504321 (base,heuristic,coalesce,both) — logs -> /perf/jobs/1768504321
Jon: Can we add CDFs (msg size) + p99 per-strategy on console? helps reviewers and PM.
Marta: filing small dashboard ticket, will link to sweep results. also adding memory RSS monitor in case coalesce increases in-flight buffer use.
Sahil: FYI coalescing may increase peak NVMe io during prefetch; will monitor.
Kevin: If both changes improve tail without hurting avg, plan a canary on dedicated pools and roll to hosted later.
Jon: cc @eng-sre for canary gating.
Marta: will report back once sweep completes. thanks :pray:
